title: Germany's AfD Scores Best-Ever Result in State Election
description:
Far-right party Alternative for Germany (AfD) scored its best-ever result in a state election in Saxony-Anhalt, securing 44% of the vote on Sunday. This comes amid growing public discontent with the political establishment and delivers a powerful blow to Chancellor Friedrich Merz. Bloomberg's Oliver Crook reports.
